entities.name: Gerda Tirén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gerda Maria Tirén, née Rydberg was a Swedish painter and illustrator. She did landscapes from France and Sweden, children's portraits, and genre scenes. Her illustrations were often featured in the magazine Jultomten.
